# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Do not open a public issue.**

Report it privately through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/saturadev/satura-space-bugs/security/advisories/new).
Only you and the maintainers can see the report until we publish an advisory.

Please include what you'd need if you were on the receiving end: the affected
version, what an attacker can actually achieve, and the steps to reproduce it.

We aim to acknowledge a report within 72 hours. If you'd like credit in the
advisory, say so — we're happy to give it.

## Supported versions

Only the latest released version of Satura Space is supported. Fixes ship in a
new release rather than as patches to older builds, so please confirm on the
current version before reporting.
